row.evidence: Pulumi's pricing page lists 'Automatic group & user sync (SCIM)' under Enterprise ($2,000/month, 'Everything in Pro, plus'), and the SCIM docs say "This Pulumi Cloud feature is available in the Enterprise edition."
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated), but plans were renamed and repriced since June: tiers are now Free ($0, 1 user), Essentials ($40/mo, unlimited users), Pro ($400/mo, adds SAML/SSO and audit logs) and Enterprise ($2,000/mo, adds SCIM), each including usage Credits with overage billed at $1/Credit. June's Team ($40), Enterprise ($400) and Business Critical (SCIM) map to Essentials, Pro and Enterprise. June's '~$50K+ annual min' and '~$4/u/mo' normalisation have no first-party source and were dropped; prices are flat, so per-user fields are null. Prices shown are monthly; no annual price is listed. SCIM 2.0 requires SAML SSO, deactivates rather than deletes users, syncs groups to teams, and does not set roles. The REST API reference still uses the old edition names.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Flat monthly price plus usage billed in Credits.

auth.token_source: Pulumi Cloud > organization Settings > Access Management > SCIM section > generate token
auth.notes: One token per organization; regenerating invalidates the old one; switching away from SAML revokes it.

deprovision.data_retained: Account and its history are preserved; active=false removes access to the organization and is reversible by reactivation. Deleting a group deletes the team and its granted access, but not its members.

pagination.notes: Users only; group search is unpaginated.

custom.how: Only the core SCIM 2.0 schemas are implemented; other attributes fail with 400 invalidPath.

attributes.notes: externalId accepted on users but never stored.

roles.how: roles/entitlements not implemented; users are created as members and roles are changed in the Pulumi Cloud console.

limitations.text: Requires SAML SSO; one Pulumi organization per SCIM application.
No user deletion, no roles, no Enterprise User extension, no bulk, no sorting; userName is immutable.
Group pushes fail entirely if any member is not yet provisioned or is deactivated; SCIM team deletions are not recorded in the audit log.
SCIM-created accounts are organization-managed and cannot join other Pulumi organizations.

auth.notes: Personal, organization or team access tokens sent as 'Authorization: token {token}'.

capabilities.notes: Users must already have a Pulumi account to be added; DELETE removes the member from the organization. create_user false because the add-member endpoint requires an existing account.

endpoints.purpose: Add an existing Pulumi user with a built-in role
Batch-create email invites with role and teams

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event filters reviewed cover stack, preview, update and deployment events; no member events seen.

limitations.text: REST API reference still uses retired edition names (Enterprise and Business Critical; Team Starter and Team Growth).

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/pulumi/ returns 404; Pulumi's guide enables SCIM on the customer's own Pulumi SAML app in Okta.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (pulumi-tutorial 404); guide uses the enterprise app configured for SSO.

onelogin.notes: Pulumi's guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app.
